entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. I just need the shipping label.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your order number, please?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. It looks like it was delivered on December 24th, about 15 days ago.
Before we go any further, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
There's no fault. I don't want it. My situation changed. Just send the label.

I understand, but I do need to let you know, our policy for the VeloBand Pulse is a strict 10-day return window. Since it's been 15 days, it's technically outside of that period for a standard return.

Listen, I didn't have time to worry about a 10-day window. My husband had a sudden medical emergency right before his deployment. He was in the hospital and needed unexpected surgery. That's where my focus has been, not on returning this.
Oh, I am so sorry to hear that. I hope everything is alright with him. Please disregard what I just said about the policy. That absolutely qualifies as an exception.
So you can process the return?

Yes, absolutely. Given the emergency with the hospital stay and the surgery, I have the authority to make a one-time exception for a full refund. I'm generating a prepaid return label and emailing it to you as we speak. Do you see it in your inbox?
Hold on... Yes, I just got it. Okay, that's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, the full refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your husband a swift recovery.
